result.rationale: TopicEmbed.import calls PostCreator with cook_method: raw_html, and Post#cook returns raw unsanitized when cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]; the embed view renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. RSS content from SiteSetting.feed_polling_url (i.content) is stored verbatim without sanitization, so a malicious feed entry yields stored XSS. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a security vulnerability. In poll_feed.rb, RSS content is imported via `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` where content comes from `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. In topic_embed.rb, posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. In post.rb, when cook_method is raw_html, the cook method returns `raw` directly without any sanitization. In best.html.erb, the content is rendered with `raw post.cooked`, which outputs HTML without escaping. This chain allows arbitrary HTML/JavaScript from RSS feeds to be stored and rendered, creating a stored XSS vulnerability.
